title: Apply buildSrc, Included Builds, and Build-Logic Boundaries
prompt: Migrate shared helpers from buildSrc to an included build with stable plugin IDs, explicit catalogue access, dependency verification and TestKit tests.
successCriteria: The task, variant or dependency model and expected artifact are explicit.
Lazy inputs, outputs and dependencies behave correctly for changed, unchanged and failure paths.
Functional tests plus performance, compatibility, security and rollback evidence are documented.
hints: Inspect the requested graph and resolved model before adding ordering or resolution rules.
Test a second run and one meaningful input change; success once is insufficient.
solutionOutline: Model the workflow with public typed APIs and complete data flow.
Test clean, incremental, parallel/cached and failure behaviour, then measure the intended workflow.
verification: Run in a clean and relocated fixture plus the representative project workflow.
Record task outcomes, generated artifact, critical path and regression guard.
